# Vauchi Protocol Specification

> Protocols, security claims, wire schemas and reproducible test vectors
> for Vauchi's updatable contact cards. This specification is a draft.

Read the claims alongside their assumptions and limits. The implementing
code is public at https://gitlab.com/vauchi/core; where prose and code
disagree, report the discrepancy rather than assuming a guarantee.

## Start here

- [Introduction](https://vauchi.app/spec/index.md): scope and status
- [Conventions](https://vauchi.app/spec/conventions.md): normative vocabulary
- [Attackers](https://vauchi.app/spec/attackers.md): adversaries and assumptions
- [Security claims](https://vauchi.app/spec/claims.md): guarantees and limits

## Protocols and verification

- [In-person exchange](https://vauchi.app/spec/protocols/in-person-exchange.md)

- [Relay](https://vauchi.app/spec/protocols/relay.md)
- [Recovery](https://vauchi.app/spec/protocols/social-recovery.md)
- [Test vectors](https://vauchi.app/spec/vectors.md)
- [Wire schemas](https://vauchi.app/spec/schemas.md)
